title: Turning the page on front matter: Wishing Nan Eckardt a joyful retirement
content: It is with great appreciation and a touch of sadness that we mark the occasion of the retirement of Nancy (Nan) Eckardt, our long-serving Senior Features Editor at The Plant Cell. Nan has been an integral part of our editorial team for over two decades, bringing to the journal unparalleled dedication, expertise, and a passion for excellent science and writing.
